name: 03 · Expense Submission — WhatsApp Photo → R2 → PostgreSQL

nodes.name: WhatsApp Inbound Webhook
nodes.notes: ⚙ CONFIGURE: In Meta Developer Console → WhatsApp → Configuration, set Webhook URL to https://<your-n8n-host>/webhook/whatsapp-inbound and subscribe to the 'messages' field.

nodes.name: Download Receipt Image
nodes.notes: Downloads the binary image from WhatsApp's CDN. Stored as binary data in n8n.

nodes.name: Upload to Cloudflare R2
nodes.notes: ⚙ CONFIGURE: Create an 'S3' credential named 'Cloudflare R2'. Set endpoint to https://<ACCOUNT_ID>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com, region to auto, and provide R2 access key + secret.

parameters.query: SELECT id, name FROM employees WHERE phone = $1 LIMIT 1;
